goals.title: Verify truth guard coverage
goals.task: Autonomous strategic goal: audit Truth Guard and completion watcher coverage. Verify Google Sheets, n8n, code improvement, file artifact and generic tasks. If gaps are found, create a safe fix with smoke tests.
success_criteria: Fake Google Sheets task is rejected without spreadsheet_url.
Real n8n workflow result is accepted.

goals.title: Audit recurring failures
goals.task: Autonomous strategic goal: audit latest errors/tracebacks, classify root cause, create rollback-safe fix, and add a smoke test.

goals.title: Expand execution lanes
goals.task: Autonomous strategic goal: inspect Brain Executor lanes and add/plan the next safest execution lane. Prioritize Google Sheets real executor, Telegram notifier, HTTP validation, and file artifact creation. Keep changes reversible and compile-checked.
success_criteria: Brain Executor has a clearer next lane plan or safe implementation.

goals.title: Improve autonomous task generation
goals.task: Autonomous strategic goal: improve goal generation so Jarvis creates useful follow-up tasks after every run, deduplicates repeated goals, scores priority/risk, and avoids looping on the same task forever.
success_criteria: Goal queue contains prioritized non-duplicate tasks.
Night Mode can consume generated goals.

success_criteria: Next tasks are proposed from lessons.

goals.title: Improve Telegram operator experience
goals.task: Autonomous strategic goal: improve Telegram UX so Jarvis answers status questions clearly, does not hallucinate links, finds tasks by fuzzy text, and sends concise completion messages without spam.
success_criteria: Task lookup UX is improved or planned.

goals.title: Improve n8n dynamic pipeline intelligence
goals.task: Autonomous strategic goal: inspect latest n8n workflow artifacts and improve dynamic pipeline templates. Avoid fallback Echo workflow for complex automation requests. Prefer validate -> action -> transform -> report.
success_criteria: Dynamic pipeline does not degrade into Echo for complex requests.
Workflow result includes workflow_id and status.
